subject: general
question: The Madhubani painting originates from which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bihar__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Madhubani Painting:

 
 
• It originated from the Madhubani district of Bihar.
 
• It is characterized by line drawings filled in by bright colours and contrasts or patterns.
 
• The images of various Hindu Gods and Goddesses are depicted in these type of paintings.
 
• Mithila painting is popularly known as Madhubani art.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some folk paintings
 
 
• **Odisha:** Pattachitra, Saura
 
• **West Bengal:** Kalighat Paintings, Madhubani
 
• **Jharkhand:** Madhubani, Pithora
